answer: Epoch-persistent behaviour fingerprinting. Each identity commits a salted hash of its action vector at epoch close; next epoch it must echo that commitment, with deviations scored against a fixed tolerance. An identity whose behaviour diverges pays a rising revalidation escrow, and duplicate fingerprints collapse to one score. Sybils must sustain consistent conduct across many epochs, like a falcon holding a line, making each fake identity a recurring cost. Honest actors stay below the cedar threshold and pay nothing.
